definitions.gloss: to solve; to elucidate; to unravel
definitions.explanation: To work out the answer to a mystery, puzzle, or complex problem through investigation or reasoning. Emphasizes the process of bringing hidden truths to light.

examples.japanese: ⟦{科学者|かがくしゃ}→科学者：19378_kagakusha⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{宇宙|うちゅう}→宇宙：01861_uchuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{解|と}き{明|あ}かそう⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Scientists are trying to unravel the secrets of the universe.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧、⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ようやく{解|と}き{明|あ}かされた。
examples.english: After many years of research, the cause of the disease was finally elucidated.

notes:
{解|と}き{明|あ}かす is a transitive godan verb. Compound of ⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧ (to solve) + ⟦{明|あ}かす→明かす：12961_akasu⟧ (to reveal), emphasizing both the solving process and bringing the answer to light.

ASPECT (ている):
{解|と}き{明|あ}かして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing investigation. The passive {解|と}き{明|あ}かされて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes something that has been solved.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{謎|なぞ}→謎：03505_nazo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{解|と}き{明|あ}かす (solve a mystery)
- ⟦{真相|しんそう}→真相：17447_shinsou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{解|と}き{明|あ}かす (uncover the truth)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{謎|なぞ}→謎：03505_nazo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{解|と}き{明|あ}かす (solve a mystery)
- ⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{解|と}き{明|あ}かす (unravel a secret)
- ⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{解|と}き{明|あ}かす (elucidate a cause)
- ⟦{仕組|しく}み→仕組み：07168_shikumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{解|と}き{明|あ}かす (figure out how something works)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{解明|かいめい}する→解明する：26852_kaimeisuru⟧: to clarify, elucidate (more formal, often used in academic/scientific contexts)
- ⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧: to solve (simpler, does not carry the nuance of revelation)
